'''Richard Wolfson''' (born 1950) has been the Benjamin F. Wissler professor of [[Physics]] at [[Middlebury College]]<ref>{{cite news |url=http://smdp.com/americas-addiction-to-oil-caused-gulf-of-mexico-spill/77505 |title=America's addiction to oil caused Gulf of Mexico spill |last=Mosko |first=Sarah |date=November 11, 2010 |work=[[Santa Monica Daily Press]] |accessdate=2013-08-31}}</ref> since 1976.<ref name="VASE">{{cite web | url=http://www.uvm.edu/~vase/?Page=members/directory/WolfsonR.html | title=Dr. Richard Wolfson's CV | publisher=[[University of Vermont]] | work=Vermont Academy of Science and Engineering | accessdate=September 17, 2014}}</ref>

He is the author of numerous articles and books.

Wolfson has taught several courses at the [[Teaching Company]].<ref name="TTC">{{cite web | url=http://www.thegreatcourses.com/professors/richard-wolfson/ | title=Professor Richard Wolfson | publisher=[[The Teaching Company]] | accessdate=September 17, 2014}}</ref>

==Bibliography==
Wolfson is the author of several books, including the college textbooks ''Physics for Scientists and Engineers'', ''Essential University Physics'', and ''Energy, Environment, and Climate''. He is also an interpreter of science for the nonspecialist, a contributor to ''[[Scientific American]]'', and author of the books ''Nuclear Choices: A Citizen's Guide to Nuclear Technology'' and ''Simply Einstein: Relativity Demystified''.<ref name="TTC"/>

*(1999). ''Physics for Scientists and Engineers'', Addison-Wesley, {{ISBN|978-0321035752}} 
*(2003). ''Simply Einstein: Relativity Demystified'', W.W. Norton & Co. {{ISBN|0-393-32507-5}}
